name: What are common signs that my exterior pathway needs safety improvements?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my exterior pathway needs safety improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key signs that your exterior pathway needs safety improvements include visible cracks, crumbling edges, or uneven surfaces that create trip hazards. Persistent puddles after rain indicate poor drainage, which can lead to slippery conditions and accelerated material degradation. Inadequate or non-functioning lighting at night can make pathways dangerous. Additionally, any loose pavers, exposed tree roots, or overgrown vegetation encroaching on the path are clear indicators that safety enhancements are necessary to prevent accidents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for visible cracks, uneven surfaces, persistent puddles, poor lighting, loose pavers, or overgrown vegetation. These are all signs your pathway needs safety improvements.
